comparison.objective: Replace a toilet roll and refit its spring spindle into two sockets.
comparison.physical_skill: Load the roll, seat one spindle end, maintain compression, and steer the unsupported end into the second socket.
comparison.success_condition: New roll on spindle, both ends seated, empty tube removed and tray-placed, assembly still, and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Spring-spindle compression and two-socket seating do not test fastener torque, movable-socket reacquisition, or response-based tuning.
